name: Yarisugi! Sekuhara Nurse
original_name: ヤりすぎ!セクハラナース
source:
An experienced nurse, who despite her age is somewhat strict, and a new nurse who has come to the hospital as an intern.

Our main character is under these two completely different girls' care, and every visit sets his heart racing.

One day, the experienced nurse asks a favor of our main character when the two are alone...

"I want you to sexually harass our new nurse..."
